about.text: Italy’s cooking cream: UHT cream of at least 20 % fat, too lean and too processed to whip, kept in the cupboard for sauces; the cream for whipping has at least 30 %.

links.name: Il Fatto Alimentare: panna da cucina

facts.v: Natural creaming (affioramento) or centrifuge; the centrifuge is the one a big brand prefers
